description.narrative: Bidraget syftar till att stödja den albanska regeringen i genomförandet av fastighetsskattereformen. Syftet med Fastighetsskattereformen är att etablera samförvaltning mellan kommuner och det centraliserade generaldirektoratet för fastighetsskatt. Detta kommer att förbättra den övergripande effektiviteten genom att utnyttja stordriftsfördelar samt automatisering genom teknik.

The contribution aims to support the Albanian Government in the implementation of the Property Tax Reform. The aim of Property Tax Reform is to establish co-administration between municipalities and the centralized General Directorate of Property Tax. This will improve the overall efficiency by exploiting economies of scale as well as automation by technology.

The overall objective of the Project is to ensure full-scale implementation of building taxation using the Fiscal Cadastre in 2026. By the end of 2025, the following outcomes are expected: •Legal frameworks are in place to facilitate building taxation with the FC in 2026 and preparations for subsequent reform stages. •Technical frameworks are ready for building taxation with FC in all municipalities. •The main target groups are ready for building taxation with FC in 2026.
